about: bitGen Studio - a local AI video, image, music and editing studio. Everything runs on your own computer: no sign-ups, no cloud.
thanks: bitGen Studio stands on the work of many people. Thank you to everyone below - the projects whose code, models, ideas and tools we use or learned from.

items.what: the generation engine - every image, video and music style runs as a ComfyUI graph; its own frontend's graph conversion is mirrored for workflows
